Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Yogesh Kumar Pacholia and 
Mr. Sagar Malara, Advocates for the 
petitioner. 
2. Mr. Gopal Narain and Mr. Amar Murti 
Shukla, Advocates for the respondent.
3. It is contended by learned counsel for 
the petitioner that petitioner is a protected 
workman under Rule 29 of U.P. Industrial 
Disputes Rules, 1957, yet he has been 
removed from service without obtaining 
prior permission of the Competent 
Authority.
4. Learned counsel for petitioner has 
drawn attention of this Court to a 
communication dated 23.12.2025 issued
by Assistant Labour Commissioner,  Udham Singh Nagar to the Factory 
Manager of the respondent, whereby 
respondent was asked to recall the order of 
removal from service passed against
petitioner.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent 
prays for and is granted three weeks’ time 
for filing counter affidavit.
6. List on 17.11.2026.
7. Till the next date of listing, order 
dated 17.11.2025 shall remain stayed and 
petitioner shall be paid due remuneration.
8. Stay Application (IA/1/2026) stands 
disposed of. 
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 05.10.2026
Navin
